title: Auction policy
description: Published reserve, extension and pre-bid purchase rules.
emptyBody: A published auction’s current rules will appear here.
unavailable: Rules are unavailable. No change or purchase is confirmed.
reserve: Reserve set — a below-reserve close creates no sale.
extension: Accepted public bids within the last two minutes add two minutes to the current end, once per command.
boundary: Server time is authoritative. At the exact deadline bidding is closed; your countdown cannot admit a late bid.
held: Auction held or closed by the current sale commitment. Bidding is unavailable.
denied: Only the current seller may change this policy.
signedout: Sign in as the seller to configure current auction rules.
invalid: Check the amount and current revision.
stale_revision: The auction changed. Reload current state before trying again.
rules_frozen: The first bid froze these rules.
buy_now_below_reserve: Buy Now must cover the opening price and reserve.
pending: Purchase pending. Retry the same operation; bidding remains held.
reserved: Reservation confirmed. Continue to simulated checkout.
reservation_denied: Reservation denied. Auction remains held for safe reconciliation.
confirm: I accept this exact quote and its sample fee policy.
sample: Sample fee policy. No money is charged here.
first_bid_exists: Buy Now ended with the first accepted bid.
quote_invalid: Review a new current exact quote.
auction_ended: The auction is outside its live purchase window.
self_bid: You cannot buy your own or your business’s watch.
signBuyer: Sign in as an individual buyer to review this purchase.
auction_committed: This watch is committed to bidding or another purchase. Buy Now is unavailable.
